Transport map

Channels

5
NameKindContract
argvargv-env
{
  "notes": "--session-id dictated at spawn is the puppeteer/spaghetti join contract; --settings carries the generated hooks; --resume continues a session in place (never combined with --session-id)."
}
hookhook-http
{
  "fallback": "hook-command",
  "notes": "Loopback bridge + bearer token interpolated via allowedEnvVars (token value never written to settings). Command transport is a curl forwarder relaying stdin JSON to the same bridge (DESIGN section 16.4 hybrid bridge)."
}
transcripttranscript
{
  "notes": "~/.claude/projects/<slug>/<uuid>.jsonl; path arrives on hook envelopes as transcript_path. Observed through Spaghetti's scoped typed observeSession contract with epoch/resync semantics and no second parser. Authoritative for message content; hooks stay authoritative for lifecycle."
}
statuslinestatusline
{
  "notes": "Claude invokes the configured statusLine command with session JSON on stdin; carries rate_limits/usage data (src/statusline.ts)."
}
terminalterminal
{
  "notes": "The native TUI. Guarded bracketed paste for prompt injection (DESIGN section 17); semantics are never derived from terminal text (ADR-003)."
}
